title: Early Buddhist caves at Ajanta
summary: The first phase of cave excavation at Ajanta created Buddhist sanctuaries and monastic spaces above the Waghora River. These early structures preceded a later phase of richly decorated caves.

claims.text: The first phase of cave excavation at Ajanta created Buddhist sanctuaries and monastic spaces above the Waghora River. These early structures preceded a later phase of richly decorated caves.
Second–first centuries BCE; the later fifth–sixth-century phase is separate.

A phased chronology avoids treating the site as one continuous building project. The relationship between religious practice, living spaces and art can be compared with other rock-cut ensembles across regions.
